candidates.issues: None. Very clear instructions, accurate ingredient ratios, and providing both weight and volume measurements is a nice touch.

The dough has a very high ratio of butter to flour (1 cup to 2 cups), which will make rolling it out difficult without extensive chilling. Furthermore, creating a crimped sandwich cookie and then rolling the entire assembled, delicate sandwich in a cinnamon-sugar mixture is awkward and likely to break the seal or mash the edges.

The dough might be slightly dry and crumbly since it uses a full 2.25 cups of flour to only 1/2 cup of butter and 1 egg. Additionally, 8 oz of cream cheese divided among only 12 cookies makes for very large fillings that might be difficult to completely seal within the dough.
None. Ratios for the cookie dough are very reliable (similar to a standard chocolate chip cookie base but tailored for churro flavors), and the instructions for stuffing and baking are clear.
